name: L301
description:
## Description

"30cm cone shaped woofer.Strong magnet and strong magnetic structure made of high permeability silicon alloy steel are adopted.Cone paper is made by mixing various fibers and forming it by heating under high pressure. It is used as a diaphragm with light effective mass.To improve the space factor of the coil ring in the magnetic pole gap and to maximize the use of magnetic energy, the voice coil uses ribbon copper wire spread edgewise.Roll edge is used for the edge.A 95L or larger enclosure is recommended."

name: D51EX
description:
## Description

"Top-of-the-line excitation driver designed for professional applications such as theaters and large halls.Each unit is carefully made based on strict quality standards.This driver unit uses an excitation type.In a general speaker unit, it is ideal that the diaphragm moves in the same way as the input signal current. However, because the diaphragm and voice coil are heavy, it does not move immediately when an input is applied, and even when the current stops, it does not stop due to inertia and produces a sound different from the original sound.In order to eliminate this drawback, the excitation type unit creates a particularly strong magnetic field to make the start speed fast, and the voice coil generates a strong back electromotive force to apply complete self-braking (electric brake).The D51EX uses silicon steel with a magneto-resistance of 1/ several thousand of ferrite magnets to produce a strong magnetic force and a back electromotive force to provide complete self-braking.Excitation power supply for D51EX sold separately was available."
specifications: "Method: Excitation type driver unit | Frequency characteristic: 500Hz to 18kHz | Output sound pressure level: 108dB/m | Maximum allowable input: 30W | Impedance: 8� | Optimal crossover: 500Hz or more | Magnetic flux density: 18,000gauss | Excitation voltage: 8V | Throat diameter: 25mm | External dimensions: Width 120x Height 90x Depth 180mm | Weight: 2.5kg | DC output voltage: 6, 7, 8, 9v | Power supply voltage: 100VAC, 50Hz/60Hz"

name: ALH45
description:
## Description

"A horn equipped with an acoustic lens.In an acoustic lens, a kind of obstacle is arranged correctly in the path through which sound passes, and sound waves at both upper and lower ends are delayed to obtain spherical waves. However, sound waves emitted from a normal horn tend to become plane waves due to the design of the shape of the lens and the problem of the connection with the horn.In order to solve this problem, the ALH45is equipped with a new, small-sized special lens with a peak-type sound path inside the horn, which has high sound pressure.This acoustic lens emits sound pressure evenly as a spherical wave over a wide range of 90degrees horizontal angle and 30degrees vertical angle."
specifications: Method: Horn with acoustic lens | Frequency characteristic: 700Hz or more | Oriented horizontal angle: 90degrees | Orientation Vertical Angle: 30degrees | External dimensions: Width 429x Height 193x Depth 320mm | Weight: 2.9kg

name: HC501
description:

specifications: Method: Multicellular horn | Frequency characteristic: 500Hz or more | Oriented horizontal angle: 90degrees | Orientation Vertical Angle: 30degrees | External dimensions: Width 600x Height 156x Depth 446mm | Weight: 6.3kg
